events.title: Gun Goose - Release date and price announcement
events.summary: Hey guys thank you so much for playing the demo and supporting the game I really appreciate it! I'm happy to announce that Gun Goose will finally be launching next month on November 6.PriceThe price will be $5 USD (with regional adjustments) with a 30% launch discount so you can pick it up for for $3.50 in the first two weeksWhats in the full game?13 different guns including a sniper rifle, minigun, rpg and more! 7 arenas to gun and goose inGoose store where you can buy goose hats, goose colors
